name: context
description: Context: publishes the facts for the Sidebar footer (Hindsight, CodeGraph, git, test and fix passes) and counts test and fix passes against a limit.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn off to stop counting passes and publishing the footer facts; the commands then say Context is off.

passLimit.title: Pass limit
passLimit.description: How many test and fix rounds Claude may run on one problem before it stops to ask you; the default is 3.

extraChecks.title: Extra check commands
extraChecks.description: Extra command words to count as a test run, separated by commas (for example: make, just); the default is none.

hindsightMinutes.title: Hindsight check interval (minutes)
hindsightMinutes.description: How often to check that the Hindsight server answers, from 1 to 1440; the default is 5.

gitSeconds.title: Git refresh gap (seconds)
gitSeconds.description: The shortest wait between git refreshes after tool calls; the default is 3, and 0 refreshes after every call.
